name: Alabama
summary: Alabama's official hosts are open and scriptable. The Code of Alabama 1975 and the Constitution of 2022 live in the Legislature's ALISON JavaScript app, but its public GraphQL endpoint answers plain GET URLs with section text (script route; WebFetch gated on built URLs). Court rules are per-rule PDFs on judicial.alabama.gov with constructible names; the Administrative Code and Alabama Administrative Monthly are PDFs at admincode.legislature.state.al.us/api/... Opinions and certiorari dispositions come from the Appellate Courts public-portal JSON API (release lists → opinion PDFs, slip pagination only). Justia (WebFetch only; script refused by bot check) is the tier-2 fallback for code, constitution and opinions; LII for the Administrative Code.

citation_map.notes: Statutes need no code key: the Code of Alabama 1975 is one code, sections title-chapter-section with letter suffixes (13A-6-2, 22-22A-3) and decimals (10A-2A-1.01). Alabama courts put the code name AFTER the section ('§ 6-5-410, Ala. Code 1975'); the regex's third branch requires that trailing 'Ala. Code'/'Code of Alabama'. Ranges ('§§ 6-5-410 to -411') capture only the first section. law_aliases map rule-set citation forms to the judicial.alabama.gov PDF prefix (cv, ev, ap, cr, jv, cond). Alabama courts likewise cite rules as 'Rule 12(b)(6), Ala. R. Civ. P.'. Bare 'Rule 32 petition', bare 'Rule N(x)', bare admin-rule numbers, bare 'Act 2016-29', legacy 7-digit dockets and regional So./So. 2d/So. 3d cites are context_required. Portal dockets SC-/CL-/CR-YYYY-NNNN are Alabama-specific (4-digit year + 4-digit number). Constitution: the Constitution of 2022 kept the 1901 section numbers and gave amendments decimal sections (111.08); old 'Amend. No. 328' cites do not map to a 2022 section without a lookup. Cert history: Alabama Supreme Court certiorari cases are captioned 'Ex parte <petitioner>'; 'cert. denied (Ala. ...)' routes to the release lists, and the court parenthetical has negative lookbehinds so it does not double-route. No public-domain citation format; unpublished Court of Civil/Criminal Appeals decisions are 'no-opinion' affirmances or unpublished memoranda (table cites in So. 3d). CourtListener ids from memory, unverified. Independent-check fixes 2026-10-17: prose 'Section 6-5-410 of the Code of Alabama 1975' added; admin-code regex accepts three-part rules (220-2-.01); the court-parenthetical branch carries fixed-width negative lookbehinds for 'denied/quashed/granted/dismissed, <vol> So. 2d|3d <page> ' (and '___'), so 'cert. denied, 987 So. 3d 12 (Ala. 2019)' routes only to certiorari history. Spacing variants ('So.3d') are not covered by the lookbehinds.

sources.title: Code of Alabama 1975 (ALISON, via its public GraphQL endpoint)
sources.official_status_evidence: Served by the Legislature's site (meta: 'Official website of the Alabama Legislature ... access the Code and Constitution of Alabama'). No statement that the online Code text is official or authenticated was found; the app shell renders none.
sources.coverage: Whole Code of Alabama 1975, section text plus history notes; versions with future effective dates are kept (effectiveDate/supersessionDate fields).

access.pattern_rules: {section} = the full section number exactly as cited, e.g. 6-5-410, 13A-6-2, 22-22A-3, 10A-2A-1.01 (title letters upper-case). The URL is the URL-encoded GraphQL query {codesOfAlabama(where:{type:{eq:Section},displayId:{eq:"<section>"}}){data{displayId title effectiveDate supersessionDate content history}}}. Response is JSON; 'content' holds the text with subsection line breaks, 'history' the Acts list. Enclosing article/chapter and its section range: query {codesOfAlabama(where:{codeId:{in:["<parentId>"]}}){data{displayId title sectionRange parentId}}} using parentId from the section. The human page https://alison.legislature.state.al.us/code-of-alabama?section={section} is a JavaScript shell (no text to either tool). A nonexistent or mistyped section returns HTTP 200 with {"data":{"codesOfAlabama":{"data":[]}}} (39 chars), not a 404 or error: empty data[] means no such section (check the cite, or it may be repealed/renumbered). The parent node may be an Article, Part or Division (7-2-314's parent is 'Part 3'), not always an Article.
access.navigation: Index nodes carry sectionRange (e.g. 'Article 23 Death.' §6-5-410 to §6-5-411). codeOfAlabamaScaffold returns the whole hierarchy (codeId/parentId/displayId, ~1.15M chars).

automation.robots_txt: none: /robots.txt returns the app's HTML page (200 text/html), no rules; fetch_doc.py check: robots permits
automation.notes: The site is a Next.js app (code-of-alabama page = 1,822 chars of navigation only). The GraphQL endpoint (NEXT_PUBLIC_FE_GRAPHQL_URL in the page config) accepts GET with ?query=. WebFetch of https://alison.legislature.state.al.us/code-of-alabama was refused by the URL-provenance gate (unanswered permission prompt); GraphQL URLs are built, so expect the same. Use the script.

currency.where: none stated (effectiveDate is null for in-force text)

sections with delayed amendments may return more than one version; check effectiveDate/supersessionDate
text is JSON-escaped (\n, \" ) - verify quotes against the decoded content
missing section = empty data[] with HTTP 200, no error

sources.title: Alabama Appellate Courts Public Portal (release lists and opinion PDFs, JSON API)
sources.official_status_evidence: Linked from judicial.alabama.gov court pages as 'Decisions and Opinions Released After May 19, 2023'. Opinions carry the notice that they are subject to formal revision before publication in Southern Reporter.
sources.coverage: Supreme Court, Court of Civil Appeals, Court of Criminal Appeals release lists from May 2023 (SC: 155+ lists); dockets searchable back to at least 2002 (e.g. 2011207, 1200113).

access.pattern_rules: courtUUID: Supreme Court 68f021c4-6a44-4735-9a76-5360b2e8af13; Civil Appeals 1da1a297-c391-4e4f-9480-1bc68b46f21a; Criminal Appeals b82b30d5-bd3c-46d7-9451-1cb05e470873. (1) Release lists: https://publicportal-api.alappeals.gov/courts/cms/publications?courtID={courtUUID}&page=0&size=10&sort=publicationDate,desc (page is 0-based) → publicationUUID. (2) List detail: https://publicportal-api.alappeals.gov/courts/{courtUUID}/cms/publication/{publicationUUID} → JSON key publicationItems: each with caseNumber, caseInstanceUUID, decision, title and documents[{documentName:'Opinion', documentLinkUUID}]. (3) Opinion PDF: url_pattern. Docket lookup: https://publicportal-api.alappeals.gov/courts/{courtUUID}/cms/cases/search?caseNumber={docket} (or /courts/cms/cases?caseHeader.caseNumber={docket}) → caseInstanceUUID; docket entries: /courts/{courtUUID}/cms/cases/{caseInstanceUUID}/docketentries?size=100.
access.navigation: court + date → release list for that Friday → item by docket → Opinion documentLinkUUID → PDF

automation.robots_txt: publicportal.alappeals.gov: robots.txt returns app HTML (no rules); publicportal-api.alappeals.gov: 404 JSON (no rules)
automation.notes: The portal UI is a JavaScript app (apiRoot in /properties.js). The portal's own search URL exceeded WebFetch's URL length limit (proxy 403); API URLs were provenance-gated for WebFetch.
